name: Twin Cities Concierge Demo Vibe Check
description: Evaluation set designed to test core local expertise, coffee and jazz database precision, and itinerary synthesis.

parts.text: I want to spend a Saturday in Minneapolis. Can you recommend a cozy coffee shop for the morning, and a live jazz club to visit that night? Tell me what music style they play.
Are there any good coffee shops over in St. Paul? I'm looking for a quiet spot to read for a few hours.
Is there any live jazz happening this Friday night? I'd love to see a band play swing or bebop.
